METRIC

Meteorological forcing

Meteorological forcing of the METRIC chain from weather stations: the standard station table and its quality control, the variables derived from the observations and the reference evapotranspiration (grass ETo of FAO-56, alfalfa ETr of the ASCE-EWRI standardized equation).

Station data and quality control

Standard table of station metadata and observations (UTC timestamps, contract units, provenance) and its quality control, which flags records without modifying them.

ef_station_table()
Standard table of weather station data
ef_station_qc()
Quality control of the standard station table

Psychrometric constant, saturation and actual vapour pressure, dew point, wind speed at 2 m, extraterrestrial and clear-sky radiation (FAO-56).

Reference evapotranspiration

Net radiation and soil heat flux of the reference surface and the reference evapotranspiration, with explicit reference crop, time step and standard; the reference evapotranspiration series of the stations, at the overpass time and as daily sums.

ef_ref_net_radiation()
Net radiation of the reference surface
ef_ref_soil_heat_flux()
Soil heat flux of the reference surface
ef_ref_et()
Reference evapotranspiration (grass ETo, alfalfa ETr)
ef_station_ref_et()
Reference evapotranspiration at weather stations

Spatial regionalization (GWR)

Regionalization of meteorological station variables over the working grid: an orchestrator that projects the stations, extracts the covariates and predicts by blocks with terra, the comparison configurations (representative station, global regression, inverse distance weighting) and geographically weighted regression with one common interface, the numeric GWR core (plain vectors and matrices in a projected CRS, explicit kernel, bandwidth and criterion, auditable bandwidth profiles, extrapolation flags) and spatial block cross-validation.

Regionalization

One surface per variable and target time, with a flag word per cell, the fitted models, the station table and the provenance (including the execution plan).

ef_regionalize()
Regionalize a station variable over the working grid

Methods and control

Configurations C1 (representative station), C2 (global regression, inverse distance weighting) and C3 (GWR), without defaults for the scientific choices, and the settings of the block prediction.

ef_method_gwr()
Regionalization by geographically weighted regression (C3)
ef_method_station()
Regionalization by a representative station (C1)
ef_method_ols()
Regionalization by global linear regression (C2)
ef_method_idw()
Regionalization by inverse distance weighting (C2)
ef_predict_control()
Control of the prediction of a regionalized surface
